usage: ash <verb> [<positional>...] [--key value | --key=value]... [--format pretty|json|msgpack]

verbs (phase 2):
  read    --path <p> [--range start:end] [--unit lines|bytes] [--bytes N] [--meta true|false]
  write   --path <p> --content <text|-> [--encoding utf-8|base64] [--mkdir true|false]
          [--no-clobber true|false]
  edit    --path <p> [--old <text>] [--new <text>] [--all true|false] [--dry true|false]
          --path <p> [--range start:end] [--new <text>] [--dry true|false]
          --path <p> [--patch <diff|->] [--dry true|false]
  diff    --path <p> [--other <p>] [--content <text|->] [--context N] [--stat true|false]
  find    --path <p> [--glob <pattern>] [--type any|file|dir|symlink] [--depth N] [--limit N]
          [--exclude <pattern>] [--hidden true|false] [--gi true|false] [--meta true|false]
          [--absolute true|false]
  grep    --pattern <re> --path <p> [--glob <pattern>] [--case smart|sensitive|insensitive]
          [--lit true|false] [--max N] [--mpf N] [--cb N] [--ca N] [--context N] [--fo true|false]
          [--no-text true|false] [--depth N] [--hidden true|false] [--gi true|false]
          [--absolute true|false]
  git     --op status|log|diff|show [--path <p>] [op-specific flags]
               ops: status [--untracked true|false] [--ignored true|false]
                    log    [--limit N] [--range <rev>] [--author <s>] [--since <dur>]
                           [--until <dur>] [--pathspec <p>]
                    diff   [--staged true|false] [--range <rev>] [--pathspec <p>]
                           [--stat true|false] [--context N] [--bytes N]
                    show   [--ref <rev>] [--pathspec <p>] [--stat true|false] [--context N]
                           [--bytes N]
  metrics [--last N] [--verb <verb>]
  report  [--session current|all|<id>] [--since <dur>] [--last N] [--verb <verb>] [--top N]
          [--root <p>] [--all true|false]
  stat    [--paths <p1>[,<p2>...]] [--path <p>] [--follow true|false]
  bench   [--verb <verb>] [--case <case>] [--limit N] [--repeat N] [--warmup N] [--list true|false]
          [--list_limit N] [--compare <A,B>] [--baseline <dur>] [--regress_tokens N]
          [--regress_latency N] [--record_baseline true|false] [--export_md true|false]
  test    [--packages <pkgs>] [--run <run>] [--count N] [--race true|false] [--short true|false]
          [--timeout <dur>] [--verbose true|false] [--bench <bench>] [--benchmem true|false]
          [--benchtime <benchtime>]
  help    [--verb <verb>] [--verbose true|false]
  hook    [--tool <tool>] [--command <command>] [--pattern <re>] [--path <p>] [--glob <pattern>]
          [--file <file>] [--old <text>] [--new <text>] [--content <text|->]
  init    [--path <p>] [--force true|false] [--no-registry true|false]
  uninit  [--path <p>] [--no-registry true|false]
  stop    

positional args (most verbs accept their dominant arg positionally):
  ash read foo.go              (== ash read --path foo.go)
  ash grep TODO cmd            (== ash grep --pattern TODO --path cmd)
  ash find cmd                 (== ash find --path cmd)
  ash stat a,b,c               (== ash stat --paths a,b,c)
  ash write foo.go --content X (== ash write --path foo.go --content X)

note: pass - as a value to read that arg from stdin (e.g. --content -)

global flags:
  --format pretty|json|msgpack   output format (default: pretty)

ash auto-starts the daemon (ashd) on first call.
